references.observed: Olive to yellow body, blue scale and fin margins, blue facial lines and thick lips. Initial-phase diagnosis has subdued flank bars; terminal-phase male appearance is different.

limitations: Original initial-phase Scarus ghobban visual study based on the inspected Charlie Shuetrim photograph and phase diagnosis. Colour phases vary; small dental plates are an artistic approximation, not a specimen scan.
Dental-plate geometry is original and does not reproduce microscopic dentition. Swimming movement is artist-tuned, not measured from the still photograph.
